TrailPhoto.title: TrailPhoto
TrailPhoto.description: Public route photo uploaded by a visitor along one of the premade Dorsoduro walking trails.

trailId.description: Identifier of the premade curated trail (must not be custom-route).

trailTitle.description: Display title of the premade curated trail.

imageDataUrl.description: Compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP data URL of the user's photo.

caption.description: Optional short note about the moment along the route.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated uploader.

authorName.description: Public display name shown with the photo.

stopTitle.description: Nearest artwork stop along the trail when captured.

lat.description: Optional GPS latitude where the photo was captured.

lng.description: Optional GPS longitude where the photo was captured.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo was uploaded.

/trailPhotos/{photoId}.description: Public traveler photos captured along premade curated Dorsoduro trails.
